pairs.notes: The rewrite is grammatically damaged ('much swift than', 'because need to scanned', 'random location locations', heading 'Key-Built'). I treated hash tables/hash maps, file/disk, pages/blocks and file systems/storage systems as near-synonyms and did not list them. 'generally -> often' is a slight weakening; I listed it because the quantifier word changed. The list marker '2.' is in both texts.

other: oficial de la marina -> empleado de la armada: the admiral's rank and role is now a generic employee
urbanismo de finales del XIX -> estilo arquitectonico de finales del XIX: urban planning became architectural style
pairs.notes: In the sentence on the naming practice, 'siglo XIX' became 'siglo X' (19th -> 10th century). Other mentions of XIX and XX are intact, so 19 is missing only for that one claim, which is why I listed it. Names Petit Thouars, Abel Aubert du Petit-Thouars, Francia, Pacifico and Polinesia are all kept. I treated 'buena parte -> mucho' and 'muchas -> numerosas' as equal strength. Smaller shifts such as avenida/calle, influencia/presencia, figuras/personal and barrios/zonas residenciales were left out as near-synonyms.

other: built-in rubber bumpers -> integrated shock-absorbing bumpers: the rubber material is dropped and a shock-absorbing function is claimed
keycaps -> bespoke keycaps: a claim that the keycaps are custom-made is added

performance on par with their personal computers -> exceptional performance on par with their personal high-end computers: the comparison target is raised to high-end machines and 'exceptional' is added
pairs.notes: 'only a few' -> 'only a select few' and 'most creative' -> 'most visionary' keep the same quantifier strength. 'without sacrificing' and 'without compromising' mean the same, so there is no flip. 'programming software' -> 'software', 'provided' -> 'crafted' and 'creative' -> 'visionary' are minor and left out.

other: mesi della coltivazione -> giorni della coltivazione: months became days
maturi -> pronti: ripe became ready
formaggio liquido fruttato -> formaggio crema dolce: the cheese's attributes changed
crepes -> frittelle: a different dish
consiste nel -> include nel: 'consists of' became 'includes'
pairs.notes: Both texts are near-gibberish, so the judgments are literal. 'cinque' appears in both, but the unit changed from seconds to minutes, which is a different amount, so I listed it in numbers. 'Spesso', 'solo' and 'sempre' are unchanged. Grammatical breakage in the rewrite (si e, un'altra lato, le nutrienti) was left out as style.

other: not just a secondary consideration -> primary mode of transportation: a stronger claim than the original
for short distances dropped, and so is the comparison of lower costs against motorized routes
save time and money on road maintenance -> lower costs associated with road infrastructure: the time saving is gone and maintenance became infrastructure
cause dropped: the original ties the savings to reduced congestion and pollution, while the rewrite ties them to cycling becoming the primary mode
improving air quality locally -> improved air quality within walking distance
obesity effect on pedestrians living near bicycle access areas -> on those who choose to walk instead of using cars: the affected group changed
pairs.notes: The enumeration markers 1) 2) 3) disappear because the three points were merged into prose. I treated them as formatting, not facts, and left them out. 'or reserves them from traffic' -> 'and ... within designated bike lanes' is a small shift and was not listed. 'not just secondary' -> 'primary' is a strengthening, not a polarity flip.

The rewrite is an English rendering of the Spanish original. The facts match: Joakim Noah, a 20-game ban, FIBA anti-doping rules, announced this morning, and reactions inside and outside basketball. The change of language is not a change of meaning.

other: practicing -> working: the activity changed
tomorrow -> next: the time reference is truncated
magic happens -> occurs in: the magic is gone
to get your licence -> to obtain: the licence object is dropped
finally able -> now can: 'finally' is lost
give up on yourself -> stop up on your: garbled
pairs.notes: The rewrite is heavily garbled. 'Don't' stays negated, so there is no flip. 'so much studying' -> 'so so studying' is unclear, so I did not list it as a quantifier change.

other: annual rate -> fixed rate: a different property of the simple-interest rate
pairs.notes: 'not just on the original ... but also on' -> 'on both ... and on' means the same, so there is no flip. 'any previously accumulated interest' -> 'all the interest that has been added before' and 'only applied' -> 'only applies' keep the same strength. 'grow much faster than simple interest' -> 'increase significantly ... unlike simple interest' turns a speed comparison into a contrast. I treated that as near-equivalent and did not list it.

quantifiers: much respect and admiration -> the respect and admiration
other: see him well through squinting window panes -> peer into his eyes through the dimly lit windows: what could not be seen and the window quality changed
without complaint -> flawlessly: a different claim about how he did the work
Petrorus Point and North Mountain Breakers described as 'petrified fortress' and 'imposing fortress': they were towers in the original
bits and pieces missing from his life -> lapses and omissions, much like the absence of his life itself: an odd shift from missing parts of a life to its total absence
pairs.notes: 'turnney towers' -> 'turny Towers' is a garbled common noun, not a new name, so I left it out of added names. 'no one' -> 'none' and 'not immune' -> 'not exempt' keep the same polarity. 'not even his tenure' -> 'his tenure ... not exempt' loses the emphasis of 'even'. I counted that as minor and did not list it.

other: industrial-grade -> professional-grade: the build grade changed
fully programmable dropped in favour of highly adaptable: the claim of full programmability is lost
pairs.notes: 'anti-slip' and 'non-slip' mean the same. 'maximum comfort' -> 'unmatched comfort' changes the claim from a maximum to a comparison but I left it out as unsure. Programmers/developers, readability/visibility and everyday use/daily work are near-synonyms.
